source_caption_text:
Never forget when Ye did everything he possibly could to hold in his laugh 😭🙏🏼

A throwback clip of a young Pia Mia singing Drake’s “Hold On, We’re Going Home” at the Kardashian-Jenner family dinner table has been making the rounds again. The funniest part is watching Kanye West sitting beside her, struggling to hold back his laughter while Drake looks like he’s enjoying every second of the performance.

Pia Mia was only 16 at the time, singing an a cappella version of the hit right in front of Drake himself. With the whole family watching, it was already an awkward situation, but having Kanye sitting there trying not to laugh makes the moment even harder to watch.

Drake, on the other hand, seemed completely entertained by the whole thing. It’s one of those throwback moments that somehow gets funnier every time it resurfaces.

#drake #kanyewest #hiphop #meme
